# //spec:corpus_h2, PCT's DuckDB, H2 and channel-B lanes: what docs/rust-port/PHASE3.md step 0 reports. Two complete runs
# (A, B); only what both agree on is here. Compressed with `zstd -19 --long=27`: plain decompression reads it.
# A ROW is one question. kind: B the boot layer (one per JVM, identical in all 53), M a model compile, Q a query (a
# TypedQuery, or one of Compiler's typed passes), L a shared context's lazy model-tier counts. Its key is (kind, model, query,
# doors, use).
#   model: t:<sha> a model text, s:<sha> the sources parseSources saw, in order (names and texts, each a NUL apart),
#          p:<sha> parsed records' toString, protocol:<sha> a client's PureModelContextData's toString, boot; an overlay
#          of a compiled model (the corpus's runtime and connection) adds +<database type>.
#   query: t:<sha> the query's text; test:<fqn>, fixture:<fqn>, setup:<fqn>, service:<fqn>/<suite>/<test> the runner's name
#          for it; vs:<sha> the resolved spec's toString (no text exists: 2,550 rows); compileAllBodies's text id; - for B
#          and M; set:<sha> for L, the hash of the queries that ran on that context. A text's sha is SHA-256 of its UTF-16
#          units, little-endian: rust/oracles/front's id, so the texts of t: rows are read from front/questions.jsonl.zst
#          (31,427 of the 31,508 t: query rows; the other 81 are compileAllBodies' constant id, 50 rows, and 31 query
#          texts of tests newer than that oracle; every t: model is there).
#   doors: the public doors called at top level, in first-call order, with their runtime and judge pass where they
#          take them (runProgram@<runtime>,<dialect class>,<judge mode>; run@<runtime>,<establish>; executionPlan@<runtime>),
#          *n when called n times.
#   use:   solo, the context served this one query; shared, more than one; - for B, M, L.
#   counts: table=a/b;... sorted by name. a/b is hit/miss at a lookup, true/false at a reference comparison. A table named
#           model.* is model-tier: inside a query it joins the row only when use is solo, else it goes to the context's L row
#           (first-touch on a shared context is order-dependent).
